t: Still worth it to buy iBonds yearly? - Bogleheads.org
s: I still think I-Bonds are the very best emergency fund holding, because I don't know if I can find a similar job easily, I have 8 months salary in Ibonds. If I don't use them, they will pay for 1/2 my first year of retirement and a reduced emergency fund (since there will be no job to loose and salary to replace in retirement, I will keep less in the emergency fund. Enough for a new roof, AC, at most a car). Speaking of cars, I also buy them cash, so in between car purchases I use the car sinking fund to buy Ibonds, safe but keeps up for inflation so I don't have to worry about th cash losing value.
